description: This Java class, TestConfig, provides centralized configuration management for a test suite. It resolves configuration values in the order of system properties, environment variables, and default class-defined values, mainly for setting up test environment parameters like base URL, credentials, browser type, and headless mode.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: Final utility class that manages test configuration parameters with default values and environment overrides.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the application under test, resolved from system properties, environment variables, or default.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the default username for login tests.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the default password for login tests.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the browser type to use for testing, with fallback to default.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Returns whether to run browser in headless mode, based on environment or default.

methods.name: resolveProperty
methods.description: Internal helper method to resolve configuration values from system properties, environment variables, properties file, or default.
